violations.message: The x_pos aperture cuts into the lid column of mount "EN1.H1", breaking through to its 3.4mm bore. The fastener has no material to hold it.

allViolations.message: The screw boss of mount "EN1.H1" reaches 0.60mm past the board edge, so the board bears on only part of it. Move the mount at least 0.60mm inboard.
The x_pos aperture cuts into the lid column of mount "EN1.H1", breaking through to its 3.4mm bore. The fastener has no material to hold it.
